title: ceratiosicyos laevis
intro: Ceratiosicyos laevis, commonly known as "Climbing Milk Bush" or "Climbing Milkweed", is a species of flowering plant in the family Cucurbitaceae. This plant is used in traditional medicine and is known for its various health benefits, including its ability to treat wounds, reduce inflammation, and act as an antibacterial agent. The therapeutic actions of Ceratiosicyos laevis include its ability to promote skin health, reduce pain, and exhibit anti-cancer properties. Bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
